create_category_index: create a dictionary of COCO compatible categories keyed by category id from a list of category dicts
convert_label_map_to_categories: convert a label map proto to a list of category dicts with id and name fields
get_label_map_dict: read a label map file and return a dictionary mapping label names to integer ids
create_category_index_from_labelmap: read a label map proto text file and return a category index dictionary keyed by integer ids
create_class_agnostic_category_index: create a category index with a single object class for class agnostic detection tasks
